description: Returns the records whose full name matches exactly, case-insensitively, optionally narrowed to one record kind. Use it to disambiguate when you know the exact name and want the id without a ranked search; use search_knowledge for partial names, keywords or questions. Several records can share a name across kinds, so check each hit's kind. Empty hits mean no record has that exact name.

kind.description: Narrow to one record kind. achievement, faction, title, quest_chain, mount, legacy_perk, race and instance come from the game files (found in game files, unconfirmed); item, npc, object, quest, zone, spell, lore_page, creator and realm from the knowledge release; build is an Everloot team starter talent build, not observed. Without it, every kind.

name.description: The full record name, any case, up to 200 characters.

name: get_by_name

confirmed.description: Present when player uploads confirm this game-file entry (3 or more installs agree). asOf is the date the rollup was current.

extId.description: The source's own id, such as a wiki page title.

licence.description: The source's licence, such as CC-BY-SA-4.0.

snippet.description: A short excerpt, in the source's words.

sourceUrl.description: Where the record came from. Keep it with the text.

url.description: The record's page on everloot.app, absolute: an indexed lore page or a catalog page. Absent for a record the site has no page for.

title: Get records by exact name
